title: nEBULA Optimizer Response
description: Canonical response format for an RTL optimization candidate. The fundamental artifact is patches[], not a rewritten whole design or rewritten_module.

chosen_pattern_id.description: Optimization pattern used to guide the rewrite. Exploratory rewrites may use null.

target_unit_id.description: Optional optimization-unit identifier supplied by build_request.py.

patches.description: Ordered local RTL modifications. All coordinates refer to the original SourceBundle snapshot.

rationale.description: Short technical explanation of why these patches should improve the diagnosed timing/PPA bottleneck.

predicted_wns_gain_ns.description: Model-estimated WNS improvement in nanoseconds. This is advisory only and is never trusted for acceptance.

predicted_area_change_pct.description: Optional model-estimated area percentage change. Negative means smaller.

predicted_power_change_pct.description: Optional model-estimated power percentage change. Negative means lower.

patch_id.description: Unique identifier within this candidate response.

patch_type.description: line_range is the normal local edit. whole_module is retained for simple cases but still operates as one bounded source patch.

target_module.description: RTL module containing the changed source range.

original_sha256.description: SHA-256 of target_file from the exact original SourceBundle used to generate this request.

changed_source_range.description: 1-based inclusive source-line range in the original source snapshot.

replacement_text.description: Exact replacement source text for changed_source_range.

$comment: v2.2: diagnostic focus is advisory; exact SourceBundle identity is the mutation boundary; self-check shape aligned with deterministic extractor/linter.
